resources.string: Explains loop decisions and graphs with an AI model. It only reads data: it never doses and never changes settings. Your data is sent to the AI provider each time you ask.
Your OpenAI API key. Kept on this phone only: it is never exported or synced.
Model ID sent to the API, for example gpt-6-luna
Base address of an OpenAI compatible API
Lower gives more consistent answers, for example 0.2 (0 to 2). Leave empty for the model\'s default. If the model does not accept it, it is left out.
(This model does not accept a temperature setting, so it was left out.)
Added to the built-in instructions, for example how long answers should be. Leave empty for the default.
